mcqs.question: Which club won the Durand Cup 2026 final, defeating Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4–1 and ending a 22-year wait for the title?
options: Both East Bengal FC and Mohun Bagan Super Giant jointly
mcqs.explanation: East Bengal FC won the Durand Cup 2026 final by defeating Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4–1, after last winning the tournament in 2004. Mohun Bagan Super Giant was the defeated finalist, while the Armed Forces run the tournament rather than winning this final.
